operators.name: group_norm_forward
semantics: Computes group normalization: for each batch and group, normalize the channels in that group using mean and variance over (group_channels, height, width).
If weight is None, no scaling; if bias is None, no shift.
Formula: y = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * weight + bias, where mean and var are per (batch, group) computed over all elements in that group.
Supports input with arbitrary strides by treating contiguous or using equivalent indexing; output has same shape and stride as input.
Passing num_groups equal to channels reduces to instance norm; num_groups=1 reduces to layer norm.
All computations are performed on CUDA using custom extension, returning a new tensor.
Applies F.group_norm with weight=None, bias=None, eps=1e-05, num_groups=self.num_groups.
Input and output shape [512, 3, 320, 320], dtype float32, device cuda.
The group_norm operation normalizes each of the 3 channels per sample (since num_groups=3 equals channels, it is instance norm).
